randomChallengeDesc: Get matched with an opponent of similar skill and solve a problem head-to-head. The faster solver wins Elo and tokens!
step1: 1. Click "Find Opponent" to enter the matchmaking queue
step2: 2. Once matched, both players receive the same problem
step3: 3. Solve the problem on Codeforces as fast as you can
step4: 4. Report your result -- first to solve wins more tokens
step5: 5. Both players' Elo ratings are updated based on the outcome
findingOpponentDesc: Waiting for a suitable opponent. This may take a moment.
opponentFoundDesc: Your match is ready. Click start to reveal the problem!

pve.title: Random Challenge (Solo)
pve.description: Face a mystery problem with hidden difficulty and tags. Solve it to earn Elo, PP, and tokens -- with bonus rewards for beating problems above your level!
pve.step1: 1. Click "Start Solo Challenge" to receive a mystery problem
pve.step2: 2. Problem rating and tags are hidden -- shown as "???"
pve.step3: 3. Solve the problem on Codeforces, then report your result
pve.step4: 4. Rating and tags are revealed after you submit or quit
pve.step5: 5. Beat problems above your Elo level for bonus overkill rewards!
pve.overkillDesc: You conquered a problem above your level! Token multiplier: x{{multiplier}}
